author: Netuxx
body:
Since the most played games on Avicus are Nebula, Walls and Nexus the other games are empty or almost empty. Sometimes some people want to play them but they are not enought players to start the match. So basicly /call would be a command to fix that.

Just doing /call you send a message to your friends online on the network saying that players are waiting to play on the server you are at, the server name, the amount of players left, etc.

For prevent spam it could be added a delay (like, you can use it every 1 hour) or that only Donator Ranks can use it.

~Netux
